name: Incomplete Delivery and Missing Items
description: Customers who purchased multiple quantities or multi-item kits only received a partial order with items missing from the package.
example_english: I bought three products and only two arrived, what are you going to do.

name: Product Defects, Poor Quality, and Sizing Issues
description: Buyers report products arriving damaged or broken, made of fragile or cheap materials, or having improper sizing and fit.
example_english: The screen protector came with several circular marks, probably from manufacturing. I do not recommend the screen protector.
Watch is already peeling after one week of use!!!

name: Delivery Delays and Non-Receipt
description: Orders suffered extensive shipping delays, remained in transit for weeks, or were falsely marked as delivered without arriving.
example_english: Expected delivery date 5/17, we urgently need this product and nothing.
It has been in transit for 26 days and so far, nothing... I find the communication system very difficult.

name: Wrong Item or Inferior Model Sent
description: Sellers shipped a completely different product, the wrong color or model, or sent a cheaper and lower-specification alternative.
example_english: Delivered product was not the same as the order.
I ordered the Spider-Man bicycle and Captain America's arrived.

name: Forced Post Office Pickup Despite Paid Delivery
description: Customers paid for freight to receive their items at home but were forced to travel to a post office branch to pick them up.
example_english: I paid very expensive shipping to receive the product at my house and that didn't happen, it was necessary to pick up the product at the post office branch, hated it.
I had to go pick it up at the post office. I paid freight to deliver to my residence!
